summary:
The available match events do not establish the broader judgement: “Northbridge parked the bus (adopted an extremely defensive, low-block approach)”.

Selected period: Match so far through 57′. This is a fictional match using real-player names; all performances and results are fictional.
fanReply: That's a bigger football opinion than the match events can settle: “Northbridge parked the bus”. I can only report what's recorded. Nothing here records defensive shape or positioning, and possession share doesn't tell you how a side set up.

capabilities.detail: A small, versioned synthetic sample labels build-up sequences and links passes, losses, and selected pressure observations. It is not complete match-wide phase coverage.

capabilities.detail: No calibrated xG or model-derived metrics are supplied.

metricDefinitions: Possession percentage = each team’s controlled-possession minutes divided by the sum of both teams’ controlled-possession minutes. Contested and out-of-play intervals are excluded.
Pass completion = completed recorded passes divided by pass attempts in the selected window.
Pass attempts, completions, percentage, numerator IDs, and denominator IDs are returned as a calculation trace for statistical requests.
Possession losses are recorded incomplete-pass turnovers grouped by the x-coordinate of the pass endpoint: defensive third <33.3, middle third 33.3–<66.7, final third >=66.7.
Final-third entries count completed passes whose start is outside and endpoint is inside the final third (x >=66.7).
Build-up events are returned only for a versioned, selected sample of explicitly annotated sequences; this sample is not complete match-wide phase coverage.
Intervals use half-aware clocks and are clipped to the selected window; halftime has no possession duration. A clipped interval omits its eventual end reason.
Event references use stable fixture IDs, team/player IDs, period-aware match timestamps, dataset version 3.0.0, and synthetic provenance.
